rules.content:
title: BNPL Account Opening Risk Signal Cluster
status: experimental
description: Detects BNPL account applications exhibiting multiple risk signals indicative of synthetic identity fraud. Specifically targets accounts opened with email domains less than 30 days old, minimal digita
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: bnpl_onboarding
detection:
    selection:
        account_type: "bnpl"
        application_status: "approved"
    filter_email_age:
        email_domain_age_days|lte: 30
    filter_digital_footprint:
        digital_footprint_score|lte: 0.2
    condition: selection and filter_email_age and filter_digital_footprint
level: high
rules.title: DL-0087: BNPL Account Opening Risk Signal Cluster (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: BNPL Multi-Provider Application Velocity
status: experimental
description: Detects identities applying to three or more distinct BNPL providers within a 72-hour window, a pattern characteristic of multi-provider stacking operations. Legitimate consumers rarely apply to more 
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: credit_application
detection:
    selection:
        application_type: "bnpl"
        application_status: "approved"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 3
        groupby: "identity_hash"
        timeframe: "72h"
    filter_provider_diversity:
        dc_provider_id|gte: 3
    condition: selection and aggregation and filter_provider_diversity
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0088: BNPL Multi-Provider Application Velocity (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: BNPL Spending Step-Up to Limit Bust-Out Pattern
status: experimental
description: Detects the characteristic spending escalation pattern of BNPL bust-out fraud, where accounts begin with small purchases (under $50) during a credit grooming phase, then rapidly escalate to purchases 
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: bnpl_transactions
detection:
    selection:
        account_type: "bnpl"
    filter_first_order:
        first_order_value|lte: 50
    filter_limit_usage:
        max_order_pct_of_limit|gte: 85
    filter_timespan:
        days_first_to_max_order|lte: 14
    condition: selection and filter_first_order and filter_limit_usage and filter_timespan
level: critical
rules.title: DL-0089: BNPL Spending Step-Up to Limit Bust-Out Pattern (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: BNPL Item-Not-Received Claim Velocity
status: experimental
description: Detects accounts filing three or more item-not-received (INR) claims within a 90-day rolling window where the average disputed order value exceeds $300. Legitimate INR dispute rates are under 1% of or
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: bnpl_disputes
detection:
    selection:
        dispute_type: "item_not_received"
        account_type: "bnpl"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 3
        groupby: "account_id"
        timeframe: "90d"
    filter_high_value:
        avg_disputed_order_value|gte: 300
    condition: selection and aggregation and filter_high_value
level: high
rules.title: DL-0090: BNPL Item-Not-Received Claim Velocity (Sigma)

rules.content:
title: BNPL Cross-Account Device Clustering
status: experimental
description: Detects four or more distinct BNPL accounts created from or accessed by the same device fingerprint within a 30-day window, indicating potential synthetic identity ring activity or account farming ope
logsource:
    product: ecommerce
    service: bnpl_onboarding
detection:
    selection:
        event_type: "account_creation"
        account_type: "bnpl"
    aggregation:
        count|gte: 4
        groupby: "device_fingerprint_hash"
        timeframe: "30d"
    condition: selection and aggregation
level: high
rules.title: DL-0091: BNPL Cross-Account Device Clustering (Sigma)
